name: Nemesis
author: Florent
description: Fly under the ball portal between the saw as the ship at 26.5%. Stay on the floor as the ship until 33% where you can fly up, land on the platform and touch the invisible slower speed portal and then enter the bottom of the wave portal to be able to play the following section at a slower speed. At 56%, you will enter a speed and size portal. Play the rest of the level normally from there.
